title: T5.3 Message Broker Integration Interface
description: Defines the message broker topics, direction, and payload schemas for inter-component communication in the T5.3 Agentic Wrapper Framework.

topics.name: pilot.events.raw
topics.description: Raw security events arriving from pilot tools (OTE SIEM, Siemens SCADA monitors). Entry point for the T5.3 pipeline.

payload.description: Wraps the raw event string or object under a 'raw' key.

topics.name: t53.results
topics.description: ExecutionResult published after each event is fully processed by the pipeline. Consumed by T5.4 orchestration and monitoring systems.

topics.name: t53.canonical_events
topics.description: CanonicalEvent published by T5.3 C1 after normalisation. In INTEGRATED mode T5.4 consumes this to call T5.1 RAG and T5.2 agent catalogue, then dispatches an ActionRequest back via t53.action_requests. Also published in STANDALONE mode for observability.

topics.name: t53.action_requests
topics.description: ActionRequest dispatched by T5.4 to T5.3 after agent selection (INTEGRATED mode only). T5.3 runs C5 guardrail and C3+C4 execution on receipt.

topics.name: t53.policy_updates
topics.description: C3 NL→Rego policy rules published by T5.3 for T5.5 consumption. T5.5 (Industry Specific Agentic Security Blueprints — STAM) uses these to refine ZTA blueprints through stakeholder co-design sessions. Published in INTEGRATED mode only; fire-and-forget (T5.3 does not await T5.5 acknowledgement).

payload.description: Policy update message with translated Rego rule.

schema.rego_rule: string — OPA/Rego rule generated by C3 PolicyTranslator

topics.name: t53.actions.dispatch
topics.description: Action dispatch messages published by T5.3 C4 for pilot tools. Each pilot's cybersecurity tools (SIEM, IAM, SCADA, fraud engines, etc.) subscribe and execute the requested actions autonomously. Published in INTEGRATED mode only; fire-and-forget (T5.3 does not await tool confirmation).

payload.description: Action dispatch message for pilot tool execution.

topics.name: dt.events.synthetic
topics.description: Synthetic events injected by WP3 STAM/D-VISOR for Digital Twin simulation. Processed identically to real events when VIGILANCE_SIMULATION=digital_twin is set. Enables end-to-end pipeline validation without live pilot tool connections.
consumers: T53Pipeline — full pipeline (digital twin simulation mode)

payload.description: Same schema as pilot.events.raw; distinguished by topic only.
